attend.question: How do I attend the LIVE session?
attend.answer: Live sessions run {{workshop.dateRangeLong}}, from {{workshop.sessionTime}}. Every session is LIVE on Zoom with Coach Abhishek Ranjan — not pre-recorded. After registration you'll receive a confirmation with all the details, and the joining link is shared in our WhatsApp community group before the first session begins.

registrationClose.question: When does registration close?
registrationClose.answer: Registration for each week's batch stays open until {{countdown.closesText}}, when the live session begins. Seats at this price are limited, so we recommend registering early to avoid missing out.

price.question: Why is it priced at {{registration.currency}}{{registration.price}} when it's worth {{registration.currency}}{{registration.originalPrice}}?
price.answer: {{registration.currency}}{{registration.price}} is a limited-time launch price to make this accessible to as many students as possible. There are no hidden fees — this one-time payment covers all 3 LIVE days, the editable worksheets, WhatsApp community access, and your completion certificate.
